explain.en: We use the comparative to compare TWO things (adjective + than). We use the superlative to compare one thing with a group of THREE or more (the + adjective).
explain.ar: نستخدم صيغة المقارنة (Comparative) للمقارنة بين شيئين ومعها كلمة than. ونستخدم صيغة التفضيل (Superlative) لمقارنة شيء واحد بمجموعة من ثلاثة أشياء أو أكثر ومعها the.

explain.title: Short adjectives (one syllable, and two syllables ending in -y): add -er / -est
Spelling changes
rows: consonant + vowel + consonant: double the last letter
consonant + vowel + consonant: double the last letter
ends in -y: change y to i, add -er / -est

explain.title: Long adjectives (two or more syllables): use more / most (or less / least)

explain.en: Never use more / most with -er / -est: say 'bigger', not 'more bigger'; say 'the best', not 'the most best'. Use 'than' with the comparative and 'the' with the superlative.

grammar.title: As … as and Not as … as

explain.en: Use as + adjective + as to say that two things are equal. Use not as + adjective + as to say that the first thing has a lower degree than the second.
explain.ar: نستخدم as + الصفة + as للتعبير عن التساوي بين شيئين. ونستخدم not as + الصفة + as للتعبير عن أن الأول أقل درجة من الثاني. الصفة بين as و as تبقى في صورتها الأصلية دون إضافة -er.

explain.title: Equality and lower degree
rows: Facebook is as popular as YouTube.

explain.en: Do not say 'as taller as' or 'not as tall than'. After the first 'as' use the basic adjective, and finish with 'as' (not 'than'). Use 'than' only with less / more and the comparative.
explain.ar: لا نقول as taller as ولا not as tall than. بعد as الأولى نستخدم الصفة الأصلية ثم as (وليس than). ونستخدم than فقط مع less و more وصيغة المقارنة.
